errors.text: The cited evidence does not support the proposed thermal-transport mechanism: E1–E2 concern FeNiCrCoCu nanoindentation, E3 concerns HIP-induced phase separation and hardness, and E4 concerns oxygen complexes and ductility.
The proposed 20–30 THz INS window is not justified and is likely too high for the phonon spectrum of this heavy refractory alloy, risking a non-informative measurement.
